added_inputs.available_width_m: Conservative clear plantable width from mapped geometry; not plot width.
added_inputs.plantable_area_m2: Usable zone area, never geographic whole-plot area by default.
added_inputs.max_plant_height_m: Project-specific visibility clearance only when sightlines and path_edge=yes.
added_inputs.path_edge: Mapped path-edge context; unknown never clears thorn/visibility restrictions.
added_inputs.support_length_m: Usable mapped climbing support length; checks the climber spatial screen and estimates stock capacity.
added_inputs.support: Explicit project support boolean; current app does not supply it.
added_inputs.vigourControl: Explicit active containment/management arrangement, not assumed from capacity.
added_inputs.evaluation_stage: candidate screening versus placement hard gate.
added_inputs.desiredFlowerMonths: Optional design output preference; no environmental score.

normalizations.loam: clay (coarse expert transfer: current clay label includes loam)
normalizations.made: Uncertain substrate; score 0.25, never automatic soil compatibility.
normalizations.edge: Hydroperiod unspecified at the edge; maximum compatibility 0.5.
normalizations.canopy: Context/explanation only. Light is scored once; canopy does not add or subtract points.

non_goals: No professional root-volume or seed-rate specification
No reviewed safety or food advice
current_ui_priority_adapter: Keep pollinators in the design-priority subset; use rewilding as its separate policy boolean. habitat/seasonal/beauty/food/learning/climate remain annotations unless a separately defined input/rule uses them. desiredFlowerMonths is optional, absent→[].
